summary.en: The persistent frame of a blueprint film: border with zone ticks, the detail bubble and label panel, a corner note, a scale bar and a title block with APPROVED BY, the name, SHEET and a live SCALE; its fixed words are swap points with Chinese defaults.
summary.zh: blueprint 片子一直在的图框：带分区刻度的边框、详图气泡和标签栏、角注、比例尺，以及含“批准”、产品名、张次和实时比例的标题栏；固定用词都可替换，并有中文默认值。

fits: Every sheet of a blueprint film; any drawing-office film that wants its sheet number and scale on screen.
notFor: Films that are not drawings; light print films that want no chrome; a frame that must carry more than five fields.

intent.en: The frame says this is one drawing and where you are in it: sheet n of N, the scale the camera is at, who approved it.
intent.zh: 图框说明这是同一张图、看到了哪：第几张、镜头在什么比例、谁批准的。

content.en: Product name (≤ 12), product line (≤ 28), corner note (≤ 24), the sheet's name, sheet number and total; optionally the fixed words.
content.zh: 产品名（≤ 6 字）、产品一句话（≤ 12 字）、角注（≤ 10 字）、本张名称、张次与总张数；可改固定用词。

fits.zh: blueprint 每一张图；任何想把张次和比例留在画面上的制图风片子。

notFor.zh: 不是图纸的片子；不想要边框的浅色印刷风；要放五个以上字段的图框。

pairs.note: the approval stamp lands in its APPROVED BY cell

en: The label panel folds while the camera is pushed in; a host that does not pass the fold lets it cover the sheet title.
zh: 镜头推近时标签栏要折起；宿主不传折叠量，它会盖住本张标题。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
